doc:
Recalibrate the support target (Gsup) to what people can see (13 November 2026).

Two independent raters agreed with each other on 98% of audit items (kappa 0.49) but not with the rule (mean
kappa 0.04): the rule marks as unsupported faint ink that both people can see. Gsup is defined in the
degradation step as  clean foreground AND |degraded - background| >= 0.05, tested pixel by pixel, so sensor
noise and stroke edges decide many pixels. This script refits that definition to human judgement on
VALIDATION receipts only, freezes it, and then re-runs the evidence that depends on it.

Steps (each run once, in order):
  val-items   100 seeded audit items from the 40 validation sources (restored-ink pixels near text, as in the
              audit), shown with a wide view and a close-up; per item the features the candidate rules use.
              Both raters answer artifacts/gsup_recal_20261113/val/audit.html.
  apply P     P is the frozen rule chosen on the validation answers (params.json). Recomputes the support target
              for every validation and test image with that rule and re-runs the RQ2/RQ3 evidence (D_rq3) with
              it. Restoration, text reader and field parser are unchanged.
  test-items  100 fresh seeded audit items from the test receipts labelled by the frozen rule; both raters
              answer artifacts/gsup_recal_20261113/test/audit.html. AC2: mean kappa of the two raters >= 0.40.

Candidate rules (fixed before any validation answer is seen):
  supported = within d pixels of the clean foreground  AND  local mean of |degraded - background| over a k x k
  window >= t,   d in {0, 1, 2},  k in {1, 3, 5},  t in {0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.08}.
  The current rule is d = 0, k = 1, t = 0.05. Selection: highest mean Cohen's kappa of the two raters on the
  validation items; ties go to the rule closest to the current one.
